description: Records the movements of one mapped parameter into up to eight sequences and plays them back, with direct phase control and several recording modes.

params.text: Starts and stops playback of the selected sequence.
Returns playback to the start of the selected sequence.
Starts and stops recording of the mapped parameter; in touch and move modes it arms recording, which then begins on the first move of the parameter.
Steps to the previous sequence, wrapping round at the first.
Steps to the next sequence, wrapping round at the last.
Smooths the played-back curve and the jumps at the end of a sequence or on a change of sequence.

inputs.text: Starts and stops playback, as a gate or as a trigger, set on the menu.
A trigger returns playback to the start of the selected sequence.
Sets the playback position directly, 0-10V mapping onto the length of the sequence; a cable here disables the run and reset buttons and ports.
Selects the sequence: 0-10V split into eight bands, notes C4 to G4, or a trigger stepping to the next, as set on the menu.
Records this voltage as the automation in place of the parameter's movements, 0-10V or -5V to 5V on the menu.
Starts and stops recording, as a gate or as a trigger set on the menu; in touch and move modes it only arms recording.

outputs.text: Carries the played-back voltage, 0-10V or -5V to 5V, or a trigger each time playback reaches the end of a sequence, as set on the menu.
Carries a gate while recording runs, or a trigger when recording starts and stops, as set on the menu.

notes: every port is monophonic, and recording needs a parameter to be mapped even when the IN port is used.
nothing is recorded until a parameter is mapped: click the display at the top, then click a knob, fader or switch on any module.
Unmap and Locate and indicate are on the display's own right-click menu, not on the panel's.
menu: Sample rate — 15Hz, 30Hz, 60Hz, 100Hz, 200Hz, 500Hz, 1000Hz or 2000Hz, dividing a store of 64k samples into that much recording time; changing it erases every recording.
Record mode — Touch starts on the first click on the parameter, Move on its first change, Manual on the REC button, and Sample & Hold records one value.
Play mode — Loop, Oneshot, Ping Pong, Sequence loop or Sequence random.
# of sequences — 1, 2, 4 or 8, which divide the store of 64k samples between them; changing it erases every recording.
Sequence change mode — Restart begins the new sequence at its start, Offset begins it at the position the previous one had reached.
Autoplay after record — starts playback as soon as a recording stops.
Port SEQ# mode — 0..10V, C4-G4 or Trigger.
Port RUN mode — Gate or Trigger.
Port REC-out mode — Gate or Trigger.
Port OUT voltage — CV with 0V..10V, CV with -5V..5V, or EOC for a trigger each time playback reaches the end of a sequence.
Audio rate processing — moves the mapped parameter every sample rather than every 32nd sample.

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
